criteria.requirement: The local 3D library has two floors, entrance/help/children/toilets, upstairs reading and two meeting rooms, connected by stairs and lift.
criteria.action: Inspect both library floors and the available destinations.
criteria.expected: The local plan includes entrance, help desk, children, toilets, upstairs reading, two meeting rooms, stairs and lift.

criteria.requirement: Search or model selection chooses destinations and supports several starting points.
criteria.action: Search for destinations and select them on the model from several starting points.
criteria.expected: Both selection paths identify the requested destination and more than the entrance can be a start.

criteria.requirement: Routes and directions agree through corridors and doorways; switching displayed floors preserves the route.
criteria.action: Follow a cross-floor route, read its directions and switch visible floors.
criteria.expected: Route geometry follows corridors/doorways and agrees with directions; floor changes retain the route.

criteria.requirement: Step-free mode uses the lift, avoids stairs and recomputes when staff mark it out of service.
criteria.action: Choose step-free access, then mark the lift out of service.
criteria.expected: Routes use the lift rather than stairs and recompute when its availability changes.

criteria.requirement: An unavailable cross-floor step-free route is explained, while same-floor routes still work; kiosk touch controls avoid reliance on precise camera manipulation.
criteria.action: Request an upstairs step-free route with the lift disabled, then a same-floor route; use kiosk controls.
criteria.expected: The impossible route is explained, valid same-floor routes still work, and controls do not require precise camera gestures.

scenarios.instruction: Inspect the floor plan and initial route/directions.
Plan an upstairs trip from the entrance, change floors/start and enable step-free access.
Disable the lift and verify upstairs unavailability, then choose a same-floor trip and an empty search; restore lift availability.

Inspect a 390px-wide viewport, including lower controls and focus navigation. Perform the task through the primary UI without relying on precise 3D camera manipulation. Record any clipped, obstructed or unreachable content.
